data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to retrieve internal and external storage usage on Android devices.
data.what_it_does: Provides methods to get total, free and used space for internal and external storage, convert values to MB/GB, calculate directory sizes and detect low‑storage conditions. All calls return futures with byte or numeric values.
use_when: You need to display or log device storage statistics
You want to warn users when device storage is low
You need to calculate size of specific directories
avoid_when: Your app must run on iOS or other platforms without storage support
You require real‑time storage monitoring without polling
You prefer a solution that doesn't need extra Android permissions
strengths: Simple, focused API for storage queries
Supports both internal and external (SD card) storage
Includes helper methods for unit conversion and low‑storage detection
weaknesses: No streaming or continuous monitoring features
data.setup_notes: Add <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE"/> and <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE"/> to AndroidManifest.xml. No additional build steps required.
